_metadata.description: Post-launch requirements. Each mirrors one P1 operational target one-to-one and carries at least two automated validation layers.

requirements.description: Given reachable access to an existing host, the scenario should enroll it as a node without creating or billing anything
requirements.title: Adopt a machine the operator already owns

validation.notes: Adoption is covered by the instance handler test and creates no provider resource or reservation.
A live bridge adoption integration remains open.

requirements.description: The scenario should refuse a request that would take a tenant past its ceiling, rather than rely on a provider spend alert that only sends mail
requirements.title: Per-tenant ceiling computed from our own meter

validation.notes: Unit evidence covers held-reservation usage joined to the requesting tenant, and an atomic expiring database hold is covered by concurrent SQLite tests; live multi-process deployment evidence remains open.
Concurrent local ceiling enforcement is implemented by the atomic tenant_ceiling_holds path; live deployment evidence remains open.

requirements.description: The scenario should compare metered usage against the provider's own billing daily and raise an alarm when they diverge beyond a threshold
requirements.title: Daily cost reconciliation against the provider

validation.notes: DigitalOcean invoice-item ingestion normalizes resource duration into provider statements, and the API schedules a daily report-only comparison for the prior UTC day; credentialed live billing evidence remains open.

requirements.description: The scenario should support a second provider behind the same interface with no change to any consumer
requirements.title: A second provider changes no caller

validation.notes: Registry selection and lifecycle wiring are covered with Hetzner and DigitalOcean adapters; caller-independence is guarded by an AST test in this file's referenced provider test. Live credentialed lifecycle coverage remains open.
Caller-independence structural coverage is implemented by api/internal/provider/provider_test.go; live provider lifecycle evidence remains open.

requirements.description: The scenario should render live inventory, elapsed cost and remaining lifetime for every instance it owns
requirements.title: Operator inventory surface

validation.notes: The inventory component renders loading, error, empty and populated states with semantic state content.
Route accessibility and component states are covered, and api/compute.test.ts verifies generated InstanceService and ReconcileService inventory responses flow unchanged to the UI boundary.
